# =============================================================================
# Grand Remembrance — Chronicle Replay Event
# =============================================================================
# GENERATED by scripts/regen_chronicle_replay_event.py
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND — run the regen script if gr_obituary.10 changes.
#
# gr_obituary.11 replays the original obituary text on the PLAYER character.
# The desc tree is copied verbatim from gr_obituary.10, so replay is faithful
# to what the player originally saw at time of death.
#
# Fired from the chronicle window by gr_chronicle_replay scripted_gui.
# Before firing, the scripted_gui saves the page artifact ref as
# var:gr_replay_page on ROOT (the player).
#
# Scope rules:
#   - ROOT = the player character (NOT the artifact)
#   - immediate block calls gr_replay_restore_vars_effect which copies all
#     gr_* vars from var:gr_replay_page (the artifact) onto ROOT, so the
#     desc tree's ROOT.Var('gr_X') references resolve correctly
#   - The replay fires MID view-session (window already open). It must NOT end
#     the session, so the after block calls gr_cw_clear_display_vars_effect
#     (clear-only) rather than gr_replay_cleanup_vars_effect (end-session).
#     The player's own pre-open values are held in gr_bak_* until the window
#     closes; the close call site runs gr_replay_cleanup_vars_effect to
#     restore them. See gr_chronicle_replay_effects.txt (audit C1).
#   - Portrait uses ROOT (the player viewing the chronicle)
# =============================================================================

namespace = gr_obituary

gr_obituary.11 = {

	# .gui, they inherit it from base, so this line is identical in all four.
	window = gr_book_event_window

		# Picks the illuminated underlay. MUST be here: without it gr_wm_id

		# at once and the page turns into a muddy blob.
		gr_book_set_watermark_effect = yes

		# while this exists; every close path must therefore remove it.

		# survive, so the portrait renders fine from a weak scope.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = gr_predecessor }
			var:gr_predecessor = { save_scope_as = gr_folio_subject }
		}
	}

		# --- GOVERNMENT CHANGE ---
		# Tribal to Feudal (positive)
		triggered_desc = {

			desc = gr_govt_tribal_to_feudal_neg

		triggered_desc = {

				has_variable = gr_memory_govt_change
				NOR = {
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:tribal var:gr_govt_new = flag:feudal }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:tribal var:gr_govt_new = flag:clan }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:feudal var:gr_govt_new = flag:admin }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:clan var:gr_govt_new = flag:feudal }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:clan var:gr_govt_new = flag:admin }
					var:gr_govt_old = flag:nomad
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = gr_agot_govt_old }
				var:gr_opinion >= 0
			}
			desc = gr_govt_generic_pos
		}
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				has_variable = gr_memory_govt_change
				NOR = {
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:tribal var:gr_govt_new = flag:feudal }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:tribal var:gr_govt_new = flag:clan }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:feudal var:gr_govt_new = flag:admin }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:clan var:gr_govt_new = flag:feudal }
					AND = { var:gr_govt_old = flag:clan var:gr_govt_new = flag:admin }
					var:gr_govt_old = flag:nomad

		# ================================================
		# 6. CHARACTER PORTRAIT - The Five Sentences
		# ================================================
		
		# ---- SENTENCE 1: IDENTITY (Education + Fame + Top Stat) ----
		# Compound entries first (education + fame combos), then fallbacks
		
		# --- Nomadic philosophy (active nomad vs settled) ---
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_variable = gr_fame_nomad
					has_variable = gr_fame_nomad_active

				trigger = {
					has_variable = gr_fame_nomad
					NOT = { has_variable = gr_fame_nomad_active }
					var:gr_opinion >= 0
				}
				desc = gr_s1_nomad_settled_pos
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = {
					has_variable = gr_fame_nomad
					NOT = { has_variable = gr_fame_nomad_active }
					var:gr_opinion < 0
				}
				desc = gr_s1_nomad_settled_neg
			}
			# --- Confucian education (overrides normal education) ---
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {

	theme = death

	# ORDER CONTRACT with gr_book_event_window: close is FIRST so it is
	# always datamodel row 0; exactly one dangerous option (cover XOR prev)
	# is valid per page, so the dangerous slot is always row 1; next is
	# always row 2. The window's grids position by these row numbers,
	# because invisible options still advance a fixedgridbox by addrow.
	option = {
		name = gr_option_close
		# Renders ONLY as the red X at the top-left of the book, never as a
		# button on the page. gr_book_event_window filters the page's option
		# grid to options WITHOUT this flag, and the X grid to options WITH it.
		# The X is a real event option (onclick = EventOption.Select), so the
		# after block below still runs. A plain window-close would skip it and
		# leave the chronicle window reading cleared variables.
		add_internal_flag = special
	}

	option = {
		name = gr_option_cover
		# Return to the cover, shown ONLY on the first folio so the book has a way
		# back to its own front. Shares the 'dangerous' channel (bottom-left of the
		# left page) with gr_option_prev; the two triggers are mutually exclusive on
		# gr_chronicle_page, so exactly one of them is ever present.
		add_internal_flag = dangerous
		trigger = {
			has_variable = gr_chronicle_page
			var:gr_chronicle_page = 0
		}
		gr_book_return_to_cover_effect = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = gr_option_prev
		# BACK a page. Rendered as the arrow at the bottom-left of the left
		# page. 'dangerous' carries no warning meaning here; CK3 offers only
		# two option flags and this is the second channel, needed because the
		# three buttons live in three different corners.
		add_internal_flag = dangerous
		trigger = {
			has_variable = gr_chronicle_page
			var:gr_chronicle_page > 0
		}
		gr_book_goto_page_effect = { DELTA = -1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = gr_option_next
		# FORWARD a page. Unflagged, so it lands in the catch-all slot at the
		# bottom-right of the right page.
		trigger = {
			has_variable = gr_chronicle_page
			has_variable = gr_chronicle_total
			var:gr_chronicle_page < {
				value = var:gr_chronicle_total
				subtract = 1
			}
		}
		gr_book_goto_page_effect = { DELTA = 1 }
	}

	after = {
		# A forward/back option has fired a FRESH gr_obituary.11 for the next
		# page. Tearing down now would strip gr_replay_page out from under it.
		# Whether this `after` runs before or after the incoming event's
		# immediate is not something to bet on, so the flag makes it moot:
		# either order, the teardown is skipped and the flag is consumed.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = gr_book_nav_pending }
			remove_variable = gr_book_nav_pending
		}
		else = {
		# Mid-session: clear the replayed page's display vars only. The window is
		# still open, so do NOT end the session (that restore happens on close).
		gr_cw_clear_display_vars_effect = yes
		if = { limit = { has_variable = gr_replay_page } remove_variable = gr_replay_page }
		# Then put the window's own page data back. The chronicle window is still
		# open behind this popup and its GR_CW_BODY reads the same gr_* vars the
		# clear above just removed, so without this the body renders from vars
		# that no longer exist until the player happens to navigate a page.
		# gr_cw_page_setup_effect is idempotent and re-restores the current page.
		#
		# The guard mirrors gr_chronicle_window's is_shown EXACTLY, including the
		# `> 0` test: gr_chronicle_close SETS the flag to 0 rather than removing
		# it, so a bare has_variable check would still pass after the window was
		# closed. That path matters -- the player can close the window while this
		# popup is still up -- and running page setup then would clear the live
		# player vars that the close just restored, with no page left to restore
		# from (gr_cp_page is removed on close).
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = gr_chronicle_open
				var:gr_chronicle_open > 0
				has_variable = gr_cp_page
			}
			gr_cw_page_setup_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			# BOOK FLOW: nothing is open behind this popup, so the reader is done.
			# END THE VIEW SESSION.
			#
			# gr_cw_page_setup_effect opens a session (gr_cw_begin_session_effect
			# backs the player's own gr_* vars up into gr_bak_* and sets
			# gr_cw_snapshot_active). The ONLY thing that ever closed that session
			# was the old scripted-GUI window's close button. Now that the decision
			# opens gr_book.1 instead, that button is never pressed, so without this
			# the session would never end: the player would keep a dead ancestor's
			# variables as their own, and gr_cw_snapshot_active staying set would
			# stop any later open from re-snapshotting. Their own obituary would be
			# written from the wrong reign.
			#
			# gr_replay_cleanup_vars_effect clears the display vars, restores every
			# gr_bak_* back onto the player, and clears the session flag.
			gr_replay_cleanup_vars_effect = yes
		}
		# The book is now genuinely closed (nav-pending hops skip this branch).
		# Without this, closing from a FOLIO leaves the flag stuck and the
		# decision reports the chronicle open forever. The cover's own after
		# block covers the close-from-cover path.
		if = { limit = { has_variable = gr_book_open } remove_variable = gr_book_open }
		}
	}
}
